accept.criterion: G3 naming: every Guess mode rule (R1-R8) and test case (T1-T6, T9-T13) in docs/specs/doodle.md has a test named with its number (Telephone R9-R14, T7, T8 are ROADMAP M5-01b)
accept.cmd: pnpm exec tsx -e "(async()=>{const fs=await import('node:fs');const s=await import('./tools/harness/src/scenarios/spec.ts');const spec=s.parseGameSpec(fs.readFileSync('docs/specs/doodle.md','utf8'));const tel=['R9','R9a','R10','R11','R12','R13','R14','T7','T8'];const ids=[...spec.rules,...spec.tests].filter(x=>!tel.includes(x));const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('artifacts/tmp/verify/M5-01-g3.json','utf8'));const names=r.testResults.flatMap(f=>f.assertionResults.map(a=>a.fullName));const m=s.missingNumberedTests(ids,names);console.log(ids.length+' guess-mode ids of '+(spec.rules.length+spec.tests.length)+', '+names.length+' tests, missing: ['+m.join(',')+']');if(m.length>0||ids.length<19||r.numFailedTests>0)process.exit(1)})()"
accept.evidence: uses the harness's own parseGameSpec + missingNumberedTests over the G3 run's test names: R1-R8 and T1-T6, T9-T13 (19 ids), none missing

accept.cmd: pnpm exec tsx -e "(async()=>{const fs=await import('node:fs');const s=await import('./tools/harness/src/scenarios/spec.ts');const g=await import('./tools/harness/src/games.ts');const mf=await import('./tools/harness/src/scenarios/manifest.ts');const t=g.gameTarget(process.cwd(),'doodle');const spec=s.parseGameSpec(fs.readFileSync(t.spec,'utf8'));const reg=await mf.loadRegistry(process.cwd(),t);const m=mf.buildManifest(t,spec,reg);const tel=m.problems.filter(p=>p.indexOf('tel-')>=0||p.indexOf('page')>=0);const rest=m.problems.filter(p=>!tel.includes(p));console.log(spec.scenarios.length+' spec scenarios, '+reg.length+' registered, guess-mode problems: '+JSON.stringify(rest)+', telephone (M5-01b): '+tel.length);if(rest.length>0||reg.length<5)process.exit(1)})()"
